# Zapply Jobs — New Grad Hardware Engineering Jobs 2027

> Curated entry-level hardware engineering job listings. US-focused, updated continuously by an automated pipeline.

## What this repo provides
- A README job table kept current by the Zapply pipeline: role, company, location, posting date, and direct apply link
- Entry-level hardware engineering roles: electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, embedded systems, ASIC, FPGA, PCB
- Part of the Zapply Jobs ecosystem (zapplyjobs)

## How to use
- Browse `README.md` — it is the canonical listing and regenerates continuously as the pipeline refreshes
- For search and filters, use the public boards: softwarejobs.dev (US tech, all levels) and zapply.jobs (US early-career)
- This repo is display-only: it intentionally contains no raw data files

## Related repos
- All Jobs: github.com/zapplyjobs/New-Grad-Jobs-2027
- Internships: github.com/zapplyjobs/Internships-2027

## Who maintains this
Zapply Jobs (zapplyjobs) — automated pipeline with human curation
